photo_auto: Automatically adds a photo's capture time and location to the note's date and region.
photo_ask: Asks before adding a photo's capture time and location.
photo_off: Does not read a photo's capture time or location.
voice_auto: Transcribes automatically when a recording ends. The audio is sent to the AI service.
voice_ask: Asks whether to transcribe when a recording ends. The audio is sent to the AI service.
voice_off: Recordings are not transcribed. The audio is only saved as an attachment.
voice_needs_ai: Unavailable because the AI connection is off. Turn AI on from the desktop.
cleanup_auto: Automatically tidies up filler in transcribed text.
cleanup_ask: Asks whether to tidy up transcribed text.
loc_auto: Fills in your current location when saving if the region is empty.
loc_ask: Asks whether to add your current location when saving if the region is empty.
loc_off: Does not fetch your current location.
